higReferences.heading: Vision
higReferences.guideline: Convey information with more than color alone.

higReferences.heading: Visual hierarchy
higReferences.guideline: Use progressive disclosure to make layouts cleaner and easier to interact with.

higReferences.heading: Ensuring legibility
higReferences.guideline: Use font sizes that most people can read easily.

higReferences.heading: Best practices
higReferences.guideline: Avoid using the same color to mean different things.

higReferences.heading: Best practices
higReferences.guideline: Let people resize, hide, show, and move your windows to fit their work style and device configuration.

higReferences.heading: Content
higReferences.guideline: Ensure that each button clearly communicates its purpose.

higReferences.heading: Showing progress
higReferences.guideline: Clearly communicate that content is loading and how long it might take to complete.

higReferences.heading: Best practices
higReferences.guideline: Consider integrating status feedback into your interface.

higReferences.heading: Best practices
higReferences.guideline: When it’s feasible, let people halt processing.

designDecisions.thesis: A familiar game connection sheet explains the target and next action while automatically matching architecture behind an advanced disclosure.
designDecisions.tokens: Reuse existing semantic surfaces, primary label and primary at 0.78 for secondary content; no new accent or decorative shell.
designDecisions.typography: System 23pt heading, 17pt target title, 13pt body/status; Regular/Medium/Semibold.
designDecisions.signature: One stable target identity and four connection stages; scope and failures stay visible instead of a generic green support badge.
designDecisions.motion: No required motion or fake determinate percentage.
designDecisions.controls: Native buttons/disclosure/checkboxes; cancel stays available. Full keyboard focus and VoiceOver testing remains NOT_RUN.

contrastSamples.scope: Two representative full-coverage grayscale text colors and adjacent background within the final SCR-22 PNG identity block; not a full accessibility audit.
contrastSamples.method: NSBitmapImageRep.colorAt converted to sRGB; crop x=70%-90%, y=38%-45%; dominant background and full-coverage glyph colors; WCAG relative luminance
